hooks.command: file=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",(d)=>{s+=d}).on("end",()=>process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).tool_input?.file_path??""))'); case "$file" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; case "$file" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/web/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/web/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/web/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/apps/web/*.jsx) pnpm --filter web exec react-router typegen >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; lint=$(pnpm exec oxlint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$file" 2>&1); status=$?; pnpm exec oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then printf "%s\n" "$lint" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
